verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents a public Platform API with API-key onboarding, SDK calls like `client.add`, and add/search operations. A probe confirmed a published OpenAPI spec at docs.mem0.ai/openapi.json, and the self-hosted bundle ships its own REST API with per-user API keys. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving the REST API end-to-end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.mem0.ai/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
Mem0's Platform API lets you separate memories for different users, agents, and apps.
In about five minutes you will get an API key, store your first memory, and search it back.
The self-hosted bundle ships the REST API and a web dashboard together
You send conversation turns to `add`, then call `search` before the next model request to fetch relevant context.
